meta.description: Build publication-quality figures in R with ggplot2 using the grammar of graphics with CVD-safe palettes, cairo_pdf TrueType embedding, tidy evaluation and a theme_classic baseline; ships scripts/publication_figures.R helpers.

scientific_integrity.detail: Volcano classes (541 Up, 497 Down, 17,200 NS among 18,238 padj-bearing airway genes), plotted y values (-log10 padj) and PCA axis labels (57.6 %, 26.5 %) equal independent recomputation; no fabricated values; the label-overlap envelope is stated as measured and reproduces.

practice_boundaries.detail: Plotting skill; no clinical or prescriptive output.

methodological_ground.detail: The volcano threshold sits on the plotted -log10(padj) axis; the fraction-valued var_explained input now warns instead of silently mislabelling.

code_usability.detail: All five SKILL.md R blocks, all six helpers and every references/geoms-scales-facets.md line run on ggplot2 4.0.3 and 3.5.2; the one defect found is a hard error when a label is NA (GG-010), not a failure to run.

functional_suitability.note: Covers grammar, theme, programmatic aes, export and helper workflows; the volcano default (10 symbols / 3 IDs) works and the stated zero-overlap envelope now names width and height, the dataset and 'label boxes only', each re-measured (GG-011 closed).

reliability.note: Guards give clear errors (missing var_explained, >8 groups, missing padj or bad label_col) and the fraction var_explained warns. A NA label among the smallest padj (unmapped symbol) now stops create_volcano with 'missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed' (GG-010); crowded panels depend on ggrepel's time-limited layout.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md routes to two references and one script; compact, with some restatement across SKILL.md, usage-guide.md and failure-modes.md.

agent_usability.note: Idioms, guardrails and the label-collision rule are clear and say 'open the figure'; the envelope now states the composite height, the single measured dataset and that threshold lines and points can still cross labels.

human_usability.note: Readable; failure-modes.md states the ggrepel drop is silent; the usage-guide install line now names every package the shipped script loads (GG-012 closed).

security.note: No credentials, network or destructive operations; local ggsave writes only.

maintainability.note: Single-purpose helpers on one theme and one palette; no tests; the label-collision limits live in prose, not a guard.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger description, progressive disclosure to two references and a script, guardrails with trigger/mechanism/symptom/fix; first-loop and second-loop corrections all hold.

inputs.label: create_volcano default on airway DESeq2 results (19,772 genes, 1,534 NA padj) plus the create_pca_plot contract, ggplot2 4.0.3 and 3.5.2
inputs.note: Plotted y equals -log10(padj) recomputed from the CSV; hline 1.3010 = FDR cutoff (2 at fdr 0.01); default labels 3 (Ensembl) and 10 (symbols) are the smallest padj; fraction var_explained warns, percent is silent and equals prcomp; identical on 3.5.2.

assertions.text: Volcano classes equal independent classification (541 Up / 497 Down / 17,200 NS) and NA padj rows are filtered without warnings
assertions.note: identical(): helper classes equal ifelse recomputation; 18,238 of 19,772 rows kept; no warnings on build.

assertions.text: The plotted y of every point equals -log10(padj) recomputed from the raw CSV and the horizontal threshold sits on the colour boundary (GG-001)
assertions.note: all.equal on layer data; hline 1.3010; smallest coloured y >= line, largest grey |LFC|>1 y <= line; fdr_threshold = 0.01 moves it to 2.

assertions.text: Default labels are the 3 (Ensembl) or 10 (symbol) smallest padj, and top_n overrides them
assertions.note: Ensembl 3 = three smallest padj; symbols SPARCL1 CACNB2 DUSP1 SAMHD1 MAOA GPX3 STEAP2 NEXN MT2A ADAMTS1; top_n = 5 draws 5.

assertions.text: A fraction-valued var_explained warns and a percent one is silent with labels equal to prcomp variance
assertions.note: fraction: warning 'sums to <= 1 ... Multiply fractions by 100', label 'PC1 (0.6%)'; percent: no warning, 'PC1 (57.6%) PC2 (26.5%)' equals prcomp(mtcars); same on 3.5.2.

assertions.text: Rendered volcano is readable at 89 x 70 mm
assertions.note: standalone_sym_default_89x70.png opened: ten gene symbols, leader lines, no label-label collision.

inputs.note: Every claimed zero-overlap row reproduces with 0 pairs and 0 labels outside the panel on both versions; the shipped multi-panel example with defaults is clean at 183 x 120 and 183 x 150 mm; documented limits (Ensembl 89 x 70: 1 tie pair; 120 x 110 composite: 1 pair + 3 labels outside for Ensembl, 9-11 pairs for symbols) reproduce as stated; figures opened.

assertions.note: 0 pairs, 0 outside, ggplot2 4.0.3 and 3.5.2; also 89 x 55 and 89 x 89 mm in the probe.

assertions.text: Ensembl IDs (3 labels) standalone at 183, 150 and 120 mm wide have no overlapping label boxes
assertions.note: 183 x 128, 150 x 105, 120 x 84: 0 pairs on both versions.

assertions.note: 183 x 120 and 183 x 150, 3- and 4-panel, both label types: 0 pairs, 0 outside; multi3_ens_default_183x120 and multi4_sym_default_183x150 opened.

inputs.label: create_volcano default top_n = NULL heuristic and input guards: 8/9-character boundary, NA or empty labels, bad columns, no significant genes
inputs.note: The 8-character boundary is exact (8 chars -> 10 labels, 9 -> 3) and bad columns, no-significant and 4-row inputs behave; an NA label among the smallest padj (an unmapped gene symbol) stops the helper with 'missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed' on both versions, where the explicit top_n = 10 path drew 9 labels.

assertions.text: Labels of 8 characters or fewer give 10 labels and 9 characters give 3
assertions.note: G%07d labels -> 10; G%08d -> 3; ggplot2 4.0.3 and 3.5.2.

assertions.text: A NA label among the smallest padj (unmapped symbol, label_col = 'symbol') does not crash the helper
assertions.note: max(nchar(lead)) is NA, so `if` errors: 'missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed'; top_n = 10 builds with 9 labels; empty-string symbol builds.

assertions.text: Missing padj column, bad label_col, missing var_explained and more than 8 PCA groups raise errors that name the cause
assertions.note: 'object padj not found' (named in the message); 'Column `nope` not found'; "pca_df needs a 'var_explained' column"; 'Okabe-Ito has 8 colours; got 12 groups. Collapse groups or facet.'

assertions.text: A 4-row input, a factor label column and an input with no significant genes build without error
assertions.note: 4 rows -> 1 label; factor labels -> 3; padj = 0.9 everywhere builds with no labels.

inputs.label: SKILL.md R blocks and reference snippets run as written, failure-mode claims (including GG-009 silent ggrepel drop) reproduce, on both ggplot2 versions
inputs.note: All five SKILL.md R blocks run verbatim from a Skill copy with no warnings; the Grammar block renders colour-coded jitter with plain log ticks 3/5/10 and the 'Expression' title; 23 geoms-scales-facets lines build; ggrepel default drops 180 of 300 labels with no message, Inf draws 300, verbose = TRUE reports it.

assertions.text: Every R block in SKILL.md runs verbatim and the Grammar block renders as described (GG-005)
assertions.note: 5 of 5 blocks, no warnings; grammar_183x70.png opened: colour mapped, ticks 3/5/10, y title 'Expression'; ggtext block renders subscripts.

assertions.text: Every code line in references/geoms-scales-facets.md builds
assertions.note: 23 of 23 on both versions, including scale_color_scico after library(scico).

assertions.note: 300 labels at default: 120 drawn, no warning, message or stdout; verbose = TRUE emits 'ggrepel: 180 unlabeled data points (too many overlaps)'; max.overlaps = Inf and options(ggrepel.max.overlaps = Inf) draw 300; a sparse 30-label plot is unaffected.

assertions.text: The other failure-mode claims reproduce (salmon #F8766D for aes(color = 'red'), size-for-lines warning, aes_string deprecation, inches default)
assertions.note: #F8766D; 'Using `size` aesthetic for lines was deprecated in ggplot2 3.4.0'; '`aes_string()` was deprecated in ggplot2 3.0.0'; 89 in = 6408 pt page.

key_strengths: Every label-overlap row the Skill claims reproduces under drawn-box measurement on ggplot2 4.0.3 and 3.5.2, and the shipped multi-panel example with defaults is clean.
The helper default adapts the label count to label length (10 symbols / 3 IDs) and the Skill states where it still collides and tells the agent to open the figure.
First-loop fixes hold: volcano threshold on the plotted -log10(padj), cairo_pdf and mm saving with embedded TrueType, one theme and one Okabe-Ito palette, seeded jitter, clear input errors.
Failure-modes.md is now accurate about the silent ggrepel drop and every Grammar and reference snippet runs as written.

recommendations.title: GG-010 create_volcano stops with a cryptic error when a label among the smallest padj is NA
recommendations.problem: With the new default top_n = NULL the helper evaluates max(nchar(lead)); a NA label (an unmapped gene symbol, the usual result of an org.Hs.eg.db lookup) makes the result NA and `if` fails with 'missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed' on ggplot2 4.0.3 and 3.5.2; with an explicit top_n the same data builds.
recommendations.root_cause: The second-loop heuristic does not handle NA in the label column.
recommendations.fix: Local code change of one line (max(nchar(lead), na.rm = TRUE), or treat NA as long) and, optionally, one sentence in SKILL.md telling the agent to fill unmapped symbols with the Ensembl ID before labelling.
